D005-D006_h001.question: It's been a rough couple of months, ever since early June, I guess. They started around the same time. Sometimes they’re whispering my name, sometimes it's like a soft murmur, or even full conversations that aren't there. It makes it hard to focus, to get tasks done at work, and honestly, just to sleep. I find myself pacing around my apartment at night, brimming with energy, planning out all these grand gestures for Sarah, feeling like I could conquer anything.
